title: Deep Learning-Assisted Diagnosis of Middle Ear Diseases in Otoendoscopy Across Clinician Experience Levels: Retrospective Reader Study.
summary: Otoendoscopy model improved clinicians’ diagnostic accuracy on a held-out reader set, with matched preprint results and stated single-center limits.
ai_technology: EfficientNet-B4 assessed on 7,335 images and an independent 100-image reader set; accuracy gains measured across three clinician-experience groups.
